Some of the more common pests we deal with

Pests we deal with every day

Store-bought products are rarely effective and may be unsafe for pets and children. Only a pest management professional can provide the expertise and industry-grade products to keep your property pest-free.

Bed Bugs

Bed bug bites on your face, neck or feet? Bed bugs live in cracks and crevices in and around your bed — we find them and treat them.

Rats & Mice

Rats in the wall, mice in the kitchen or garage? Rodent control works best when the pest itself is fully understood — and we understand both.

Cockroaches

Cockroaches are nocturnal and hide in cracks and under floor covering. We find the nesting areas and treat them properly.

Fleas

Pets scratching and grooming themselves non-stop is a common sign of fleas. We inspect your pet's areas and treat the problem.

Ants

Ants live in colonies that can number in the millions. We find the colony and treat it at the source — not just the trail.

Wasps

Have a wasps nest in the house, a tree or the attic? We remove nests safely with specialist methods — including aerosol wasp nest destroyers.

Professional vs do-it-yourself
